execute_dql-find_finished_tests.name: execute_dql-find_finished_tests

input.query:
// Finished tests only: last span older than the quiet period. LOOKBACK must exceed your longest test + schedule interval.
fetch spans, from: -6h, to: now(), scanLimitGBytes:-1
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution`)
| summarize
    test_start = min(start_time),
    test_end   = max(end_time),
    by: { source_id = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_SourceID`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""), test_execution = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", "") }
| filter test_end < now() - 10m

execute_dql-find_finished_tests.description: Make use of Dynatrace Grail data in your workflow.

execute_dql-step_execution_performance.name: execute_dql-step_execution_performance

input.query:
fetch spans, from: "{{ _.item.window_start }}", to: "{{ _.item.window_end }}", scanLimitGBytes:-1
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution`)
| filter `request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution` == "{{ _.item.test_execution }}"
| summarize
    count      = count(),
    avg_dur_ms = avg(duration) / 1000000,
    min_dur_ms = min(duration) / 1000000,
    max_dur_ms = max(duration) / 1000000,
    p25_dur_ms = percentile(duration, 25) / 1000000,
    p50_dur_ms = percentile(duration, 50) / 1000000,
    p75_dur_ms = percentile(duration, 75) / 1000000,
    p90_dur_ms = percentile(duration, 90) / 1000000,
    p95_dur_ms = percentile(duration, 95) / 1000000,
    p99_dur_ms = percentile(duration, 99) / 1000000,
    by: {
      source_id        = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_SourceID`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""),
      test_execution   = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""),
      zone             = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_Zone`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""),
      te_uuid          = substring(replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""), from: -36),
      te_scenarioname  = substring(replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""), from: indexOf(replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""), "-") + 1, to: stringLength(replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", "")) - 37),
      script_name      = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest__ScriptName`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""),
      transaction_name = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_TransactionName`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""),
      page_context     = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_PageContext`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", "")
    }

execute_dql-step_execution_performance.description: Make use of Dynatrace Grail data in your workflow.

execute_dql-step_execution_services.name: execute_dql-step_execution_services

input.query:
fetch spans, from: "{{ _.item.window_start }}", to: "{{ _.item.window_end }}", scanLimitGBytes:-1
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution`)
| filter `request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution` == "{{ _.item.test_execution }}"
| fields
      source_id        = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_SourceID`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""),
      test_execution   = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""),
      zone             = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_Zone`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""),
      te_uuid          = substring(replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""), from: -36),
      te_scenarioname  = substring(replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""), from: indexOf(replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""), "-") + 1, to: stringLength(replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", "")) - 37),
      script_name      = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest__ScriptName`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""),
      transaction_name = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_TransactionName`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""),
      page_context     = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_PageContext`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""),
      test_start       = "{{ _.item.test_start }}",
      test_end         = "{{ _.item.test_end }}",
      service_id       = dt.smartscape.service

| dedup page_context, script_name, transaction_name, service_id

| lookup [smartscapeNodes SERVICE | fields id, name],
    sourceField: service_id, lookupField: id, prefix: "service."

| lookup [
    smartscapeEdges "*"
    | filter in(type, {"belongs_to", "runs_on"})
    | filter in(target_type, {"PROCESS"})
    | summarize process_ids = collectArray(target_id), by: { source_id }
  ], sourceField: service.id, lookupField: source_id, prefix: "process_details."
| expand process_id = process_details.process_ids

| lookup [smartscapeNodes PROCESS],
    sourceField: process_id, lookupField: id, prefix: "process_metadata."

| fieldsAdd process_exe        = process_metadata.process.metadata[EXE_NAME]
| fieldsAdd process_id_classic = process_metadata.id_classic

| fieldsAdd tech_type = coalesce(
    if(isNotNull(process_metadata.process.metadata[ASP_DOT_NET_CORE_APPLICATION_PATH]), "ASP_DOT_NET_CORE"),
    if(isNotNull(process_metadata.process.metadata[WEB_SPHERE_SERVER_NAME]),            "WEB_SPHERE"),
    if(isNotNull(process_metadata.process.metadata[JBOSS_HOME]),                        "JBOSS"),
    if(isNotNull(process_metadata.process.metadata[IIS_APP_POOL]),                      "IIS_APP_POOL"),
    if(isNotNull(process_metadata.process.metadata[SPRINGBOOT_APP_NAME]),               "SPRINGBOOT"),
    if(isNotNull(process_metadata.process.metadata[DOTNET_COMMAND]),                    "DOTNET"),
    if(isNotNull(process_metadata.process.metadata[NODE_JS_SCRIPT_NAME]),               "NODE_JS"),
    if(isNotNull(process_metadata.process.metadata[RUBY_SCRIPT_PATH]),                  "RUBY"),
    if(isNotNull(process_metadata.process.metadata[APACHE_CONFIG_PATH]),                "APACHE"),
    if(isNotNull(process_metadata.process.metadata[CATALINA_HOME]),                     "TOMCAT")
  )

| fieldsRemove service.name, service.id, process_details.process_ids,
               process_metadata.process.software_technologies.os,
               process_metadata.process.metadata

| summarize
    services = collectArray(record(service_id, process_id_classic, process_exe, tech_type)),
    by: {
          source_id,
          test_execution,
          test_start,
          test_end,
          zone,
          te_uuid,
          te_scenarioname,
          script_name,
          transaction_name,
          page_context,
          service_id
        }

execute_dql-step_execution_services.description: Make use of Dynatrace Grail data in your workflow.

execute_dql-test_summary.name: execute_dql-test_summary

input.query:
fetch spans, from: "{{ _.item.window_start }}", to: "{{ _.item.window_end }}", scanLimitGBytes:-1
| filter isNotNull(`request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution`)
| filter `request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution` == "{{ _.item.test_execution }}"
| summarize
    test_start = min(start_time),
    test_end   = max(end_time),
    count      = count(),
    avg_dur_ms = avg(duration),
    min_dur_ms = min(duration),
    max_dur_ms = max(duration),
    p25_dur_ms = percentile(duration, 25),
    p50_dur_ms = percentile(duration, 50),
    p75_dur_ms = percentile(duration, 75),
    p90_dur_ms = percentile(duration, 90),
    p95_dur_ms = percentile(duration, 95),
    p99_dur_ms = percentile(duration, 99),
    by: { source_id = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_SourceID`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", ""), test_execution = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(`request_attribute.LoadTest_TestExecution`, " ", ""), "(", "-"), ")", "") }
| fieldsAdd test_duration_ms = toLong(test_end - test_start) / 1000000
| fieldsAdd te_uuid = substring(test_execution, from: -36)
| fieldsAdd te_projectname = substring(test_execution, from: 0, to: indexOf(test_execution, "-"))
| fieldsAdd te_scenarioname = substring(test_execution, from: indexOf(test_execution, "-") + 1, to: stringLength(test_execution) - 37)

execute_dql-test_summary.description: Make use of Dynatrace Grail data in your workflow.
